missing_policy: Unresolved reference, unavailable evidence or absent measurement produces null/UNKNOWN with a reason and denominator; never zero accuracy or a pass.

outcomes.name: Agreement with adjudicated human reference
outcomes.unit: Applicable clip-dimension judgment under one intent and rubric snapshot
outcomes.measure: Exact category agreement and confusion matrix; ordinal agreement separately when enough pairable units and nondegenerate marginals exist
outcomes.denominator: All applicable judgments with a resolved independent reference; report unresolved/abstained exclusions and coverage separately
outcomes.requires: Independent blinded human ratings and future adjudication; not present in Pilot 0

outcomes.name: Time to evaluation
outcomes.measure: Active start/pause/resume/finish time plus total wall time; separately record preprocessing, assistance latency and rework
outcomes.denominator: Completed sessions; retain interrupted and unfinished sessions as censored/incomplete, not zero
outcomes.requires: Operator-controlled timer records; local UTC timing is recorded, clock adjustments and forgotten pauses need review

outcomes.name: Useful disagreement discovery
outcomes.measure: Count independent human-confirmed new actionable issues and fraction of flagged disagreements confirmed useful; also report false leads and unresolved issues
outcomes.denominator: All flagged disputes reviewed under a predeclared usefulness criterion, plus review coverage
outcomes.requires: Human assessment of whether a dispute changed the decision, exposed a missed issue or motivated an informative test; agent vote count is not usefulness

outcomes.name: Failure classification accuracy
outcomes.measure: Per-category confusion counts, precision/recall and macro F1 where defined; prioritize missed severe failures and separate severity from category
outcomes.denominator: Resolved reference labels; retain multilabel cases, absent classes and abstention explicitly
outcomes.requires: Versioned category definitions and future adjudicated reference; no current automated classification

outcomes.name: Discriminating-test quality
outcomes.measure: Blinded human ratings on discrimination between alternatives, explicit prediction/falsifier, control of confounding and practical feasibility; record facet distributions, reviewer agreement and rationale
outcomes.denominator: All proposed tests reviewed; separately count missing or untestable proposals
outcomes.requires: Provisional facet anchors: 0 absent/uncheckable, 1 partly specified, 2 operationally checkable. Calibrate these human review anchors before comparison; no test execution or automatic quality scoring

outcomes.name: Confidence calibration
outcomes.unit: A predeclared probabilistic prediction with subsequently resolved binary outcome
outcomes.measure: Brier score and reliability bins with counts, only after probability semantics and the resolution rule are fixed; retain pre/post evidence confidence separately
outcomes.denominator: Resolved predictions with prospectively recorded probabilities; report resolution coverage and avoid treating repeated revisions as independent cases
outcomes.requires: Current subjective observation/hypothesis confidence is uncalibrated and is not automatically an empirical probability. No Brier/calibration result until a human defines the event and reference procedure

outcomes.name: Rubric revision frequency
outcomes.unit: Substantive revision event per completed case count
outcomes.measure: Number of substantive rubric versions per 10 completed cases; distinguish editorial fixes, changed anchors, changed applicability and added/merged dimensions
outcomes.denominator: Completed cases examined, with exposure count per rubric version
outcomes.requires: Human revision reason and motivating evidence; a higher revision rate is not inherently better or worse; no autonomous rubric changes

uncertainty_plan: Future paired analysis and resampling must respect prompt/media lineage and reviewer dependence; no inferential comparison runs in Pilot 0.
undecided_before_comparison: Target production task and reviewer population
